'''Jestefad''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Priate/Legends|Priate]] in the [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Jestefad was an immense [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] considered the twin of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], but only because the two shared almost the same orbital pathways. Many [[Astrophysicist/Legends|astrophysicists]] considered Mustafar to be its [[Moon/Legends|moon]]; however, the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] forces exerted on the small planet by [[Lefrani/Legends|Lefrani]] kept Mustafar separated from Jestefad and on its own orbital path.<ref name="CE" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[2008]] sourcebook ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' stated that Jestefad was the innermost planet of the Mustafar system and had several [[Moon/Legends|moons]];<ref name="CE" /> however, in [[2009]], ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' moved it to the second position, with [[Schada]] taking its place as the innermost planet, and no longer depicted Jestefad as having any moons.<ref name="EA" />
